version_notes.26.3: Query remains the primary Content search action. UseVectors applies to TermGetBest/Suggest rather than Query itself.
Suggest on DAH supports UseVectors. Powered by TermGetBest, which also accepts UseVectors.
UseVectors returns best vectors as well as best terms.
OTDS integration can accept username/password via OTDSUserField.
UseVectors added for vector similarity through DAH.
Saudi Arabia PII grammars; Oman/UAE improvements; format subtypes; ITAR munitions dictionary.

version_notes.26.2: ImageDescription engine added; Legacy STT removed.
version_notes.26.3: Speech Medium/Large combined; OCR languages expanded; speech ~3x faster.
Adds hy, az, ka, id, kk, ms, mn, tg, uz OCR languages.
Medium and Large combined into one model; previous names still resolve.
C2PA metadata extraction; 85 new formats; improved source-code detection; AV1; XrML.

version_notes.26.1: Ask CustomizationData supports global session data; LLM extractive QA available.
Type=question_suggestion uses a generative LLM module when configured.

version_notes.26.2: ListSpeakers response format changed with the new speaker-ID algorithm.
